description:
**Data:** 10 set 2026
  
  

**Luogo:**  

Roma
  
  

**Società:**  

Gruppo Cassa Depositi e Prestiti
  
  

Cassa Depositi e Prestiti ricerca una figura di "Public and Regulatory Affairs Senior Professional":
  
  

La persona andrà inserita nella Direzione “Affari Legali, Societari, Normativi ed Europei”, nell’Area “Legale Pubblica Amministrazione, Advisory e Affari Normativi”, in particolare nel team “Legale Advisory e Gestione Fondi Pubblici” si occuperà delle seguenti attività: (i) supporto legale alle strutture organizzative aziendali competenti per le attività di advisory prestate da CDP nei confronti di soggetti pubblici e privati in relazione ad operazioni e progettualità di interesse pubblico; (ii) supporto legale nella gestione dei fondi costituiti con risorse pubbliche statali ed europee, nonché nelle operazioni di strutturazione e gestione di strumenti finanziari a valere sulle predette risorse; (iii) gestione in autonomia, per i profili legali, di operazioni e progettualità complesse relative alla gestione di fondi nazionali ed europei; (iv) assistenza alle strutture aziendali competenti nella definizione e negoziazione di convenzioni, accordi operativi, protocolli, regolamenti, avvisi e atti attuativi; (v) coordinamento delle attività istruttorie e di approfondimento giuridico a supporto delle strutture aziendali di riferimento; (vi) coordinamento studi legali esterni e specialisti coinvolti nelle operazioni; (vii) supporto alla predisposizione di procedure aziendali, standard contrattuali e modelli operativi.
  
  

Requisiti
  
La persona ideale possiede una laurea in Giurisprudenza, costituisce titolo preferenziale aver conseguito l'abilitazione all'esercizio della professione forense e/o un dottorato di ricerca o un master afferente agli ambiti del diritto amministrativo, della contrattualistica pubblica, della contabilità pubblica, della gestione di programmi e fondi pubblici nazionali o europei. La persona ha maturato un’esperienza pregressa di almeno 8\-10 anni in ambito legale (e.g. all'interno di direzioni legali di società, preferibilmente a partecipazione pubblica, o in studi legali di primario standing) e dovrà essersi occupata, in particolare, di diritto amministrativo, contrattualistica pubblica, aiuti di stato, contabilità pubblica, programmi e fondi pubblici nazionali ed europei. Il ruolo richiede un’ottima dimestichezza con l'utilizzo degli applicativi del pacchetto Microsoft Office (Word, Power Point, etc.), nella consultazione di banche dati di documentazione giuridica e una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Completano il profilo capacità relazionali e di problem solving.
  
  

Sede
  
Roma
  
  

Deadline candidature
  
  

23/09/2026
  
  

Posizionamento Economico
  
  

In conformità all'art. 5 del d.lgs. di attuazione della Direttiva (UE) 2023/970 in materia di trasparenza retributiva, si comunica che alla posizione è attribuita una retribuzione annua lorda iniziale compresa nella fascia tra € 50\.000 e € 70\.000, determinata sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutri sotto il profilo del genere. La posizione è inquadrata al livello QDL1\-QDL2 del CCNL Credito applicato dal Gruppo CDP, le cui pertinenti disposizioni in materia di trattamento economico (in particolare gli artt. XII relativi a inquadramento, minimi tabellari ed elementi retributivi fissi e continuativi) sono consultabili al seguente indirizzo: CCNL Credito e Bancari \- Testo Completo 2026 . La fascia indicata ha carattere orientativo e il posizionamento all'interno della stessa terrà conto dell'esperienza, delle competenze e del profilo professionale effettivamente accertati in sede di selezione.
  
  

Il presente annuncio è rivolto a tutte le persone, indipendentemente da genere, identità di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, origine etnica, religione o convinzioni personali e disabilità, nel rispetto del d.lgs. 198/2006 e dei d.lgs. 215/2003 e 216/2003; la selezione è aperta anche a persone appartenenti alle categorie protette ai sensi della L. 68/1999 e a persone con DSA ai sensi della L. 25/2022
  
Nel rispetto dei principi di pari opportunità e non discriminazione, la Società garantisce processi selettivi accessibili e, ai sensi dell’art. 3, comma 3 bis, d.lgs. 216/2003, adotta gli accomodamenti ragionevoli necessari durante le prove e i colloqui per le persone con disabilità.

Regulatory Affairs Expert
  
  

Alfasigma is a privately held global healthcare company founded over 75 years ago in Italy, where it remains headquartered today in Bologna and Milan. The Group operates in over 100 markets spanning Europe, North and South America, Asia, and Africa.
  
  

Over three years ago, we embarked on a transformative journey to become a truly global innovative healthcare company with a leading focus on Gastrointestinal (GI) health. We have experienced remarkable growth, nearly doubled our revenues, expanding geographically, and integrating several key acquisitions. We have also evolved our portfolio, expanded into rare and specialty segments, and strengthened our pipeline and people's capabilities.
  
  

But our journey is far from complete! In fact, this is just the beginning of a bold new chapter in Alfasigma's history. We are committed to advancing innovation and leveraging our deep expertise to provide better health and a better quality of life for patients and consumers worldwide and expand our reach across diverse markets.
  
  

Scope of the role
  
  

The role of Regulatory Affairs supports the Regulatory Strategy for Local Italian Products, both for new Marketing Authorization and Life Cycle Management Applications. The Specialist assures an effective and efficient preparation and setting up of the necessary documentation for the new Marketing Authorizations, Variation and MA renewal applications and for any modification of the dossiers of the MAs already authorized.
  
  

Your Role
  
  

Manage regulatory activities for assigned Rx and OTC products throughout their lifecycle, ensuring compliance with Italian and European regulatory requirements.
  
Prepare, review and submit regulatory dossiers, including variations, renewals, notifications and maintenance activities, with a particular focus on quality and safety related regulatory variations.
  
Under supervision, interact with AIFA and other relevant Italian regulatory institutions, ensuring timely and effective management of regulatory requests and communications.
  
Support the development, review and approval of promotional and advertising materials, ensuring compliance with applicable regulations and company standards.
  
Manage a portfolio of approximately 10 products, including both local and global brands, collaborating with international and cross\-functional teams.
  
Monitor and interpret regulatory changes, assessing their impact on the company portfolio and proactively proposing appropriate actions.
  
Collaborate closely with Quality, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Pharmacovigilance, Supply Chain, Marketing, Global Regulatory, CMC, Internal and ESO Manufacturing Sites, Artwork Dept. and other internal and external stakeholders to ensure regulatory compliance and successful product lifecycle management.
  
Leverage digital regulatory tools and systems to improve efficiency, data quality and regulatory processes.
  
Maintain accurate regulatory documentation and databases, ensuring data integrity and audit readiness.
  
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, promoting digital innovation and process optimization within the Regulatory Affairs Italy function.
  
  

Who are you
  
  

At least 2 years of experience in Regulatory Affairs within the pharmaceutical industry with focus on Italian and EU guidelines.
  
Degree in Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Chemistry and Technology (CTF). Degree in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Chemistry and Technology or, alternatively, Chemistry, Biology or another relevant life\-science discipline.
  
Master's Degree in Regulatory Affairs is considered a plus.
  
Good knowledge of registration procedures and regulatory dossier preparation, including format, content and applicable in EU and Italy Market.
  
Understanding of pharmaceutical regulatory processes and lifecycle management activities.
  
Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving skills.
  
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
  
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and familiarity with electronic document management systems.
  
Hands\-on experience with eCTD publishing and submission tools; familiarity with Veeva RIM is considered a plus.
  
Digital mindset and interest in leveraging digital tools and technologies to enhance regulatory processes.
  
Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross\-functional and international environments.
  
Proactive, energetic, and results\-oriented attitude, combined with a strong willingness to learn and continuously develop.
  
Excellent communication skills, analytical thinking, and open\-minded approach.
  
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively under pressure.
  
Strong team player with the ability to share knowledge and best practices among colleagues.
  
  

**Location:** Pomezia (RM)
  
  

Salary range 36\.000€ \- 48\.000€
  
  

The compensation range indicated in this job posting represents an estimated average range for the position. The final remuneration will be determined based on the selected candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications, in accordance with applicable EU pay transparency and pay equity requirements.
  
  

**Why Join Alfasigma:**  

At Alfasigma, we foster a culture where the courage to innovate is key to our success.
  
We offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and extensive opportunities for professional growth and development.
  
  

Our commitment to people and patients is at the heart of everything we do. We value diversity and welcome individuals with unique perspectives and experiences. We believe that open\-mindedness, collaboration, and a shared passion for innovation are essential to achieving meaningful progress.
  
  

Join Alfasigma and become part of a forward\-thinking team dedicated to shaping the future of the pharmaceutical industry.

Rome, Italy
Work Type

We are looking for a highly analytical and experienced Credit Risk Manager. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in the consumer credit sector, with a strong focus on underwriting both retail and corporate portfolios. You will be responsible for evaluating creditworthiness, managing risk provisions, and ensuring full compliance with regulatory reporting standards.

* **Credit Underwriting:** Perform comprehensive credit analysis and decision\-making for both Retail and Corporate applicants, ensuring alignment with the company’s risk appetite.
* **IFRS 9 Stage Management:** Oversee the Credit Reclassification process, ensuring assets are accurately categorized into Stages according to international accounting standards and Default Definition
* **Regulatory Reporting**: Lead the preparation of reports regarding asset quality, stage migration, and "Non\-Performing Exposure" (NPE) ratios for regulatory authorities.
* **Reporting:** delivering regular reports to the top management on risk exposure and the adequacy of the bad debt reserve
* **Portfolio Monitoring**: Analyze consumer credit trends and performance indicators to identify early warning signs of credit deterioration.
* **Policy Development:** Contribute to the refinement of credit policies and scoring models to optimize the balance between growth and risk.

**The minimum requirements we are seeking:**

* Proven Experience: Minimum 5\+ years in Credit Risk with specific expertise in IFRS 9 impairment frameworks.
* Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Credit Risk triggers and the qualitative/quantitative criteria for credit reclassification.
* Regulatory Expertise: Familiarity with EBA (European Banking Authority) guidelines on management of non\-performing and forborne exposures.
* Analytical Background: Ability to interpret PD (Probability of Default), LGD (Loss Given Default), and EAD (Exposure at Default) models across different credit stages.
* Full professional proficiency in English (written and verbal) is mandatory.

**Additional Information:**

*The Company is committed to diversity and equality of opportunity for all and is opposed to any form of less favourable treatment or harassment on the grounds of race, religion or belief, sex, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment or disability.*

*This position is based in Rome, and it is expected the successful candidate will be able to attend the Rome office for typically 4 days a week and remain flexible on the days they are required to attend the office according to business requirements.*

description:

**Welcome to St Georgeʼs British International School**  

**Rome**  



We are delighted that you are considering applying for a leadership position at St Georgeʼs British
  

International School Rome.


St Georgeʼs is the original and leading British curriculum school in Rome. St Georgeʼs was
  

established in 1958 to serve the needs of Romeʼs international and internationally\-minded
  

communities. Many of our families are connected either to the United Nations or to embassies in
  

Rome and the Vatican City. They take pride in belonging to a diverse, inclusive and friendly school
  

community committed to standards of excellence in education that are recognised worldwide.


Our **Vision** is to be the best International School in Europe where all learners discover their passion
  

and purpose, developing the character, skills and confidence to make a difference in the world.
  

**Our Mission** is to ensure that all learners become the best version of themselves, in an
  

environment of collaboration, respect and kindness. We focus on the inspirational teaching and
  

holistic development of highly committed, aspirational and resilient learners.


St Georgeʼs Senior School is based at La Storta, to the North West of the City. St Georgeʼs Seniors is
  

intentionally inclusive, but its results at GCSE and IB are consistently on a par with selective
  

independent schools in the UK. Many pupils proceed to Oxbridge, the Ivy League and to leading
  

universities across continental Europe. According to Spearʼs Schools Index 2026, St Georgeʼs is
  

among the top 10 most academically successful international schools in continental Europe and
  

among the top 100 schools worldwide.
  

  

This is a particularly exciting time to join St Georgeʼs. The school is midway through a multimillion
  

euro redevelopment of its La Storta campus. This programme has already resulted in a near


doubling of the size of the school site and includes plans for a new canteen, state\-of\-the\-art
  

performance spaces and a swimming pool. The governors last year appointed Mr. Alex Crossman as
  

Principal and Chief Executive to lead the next phase of St Georgeʼs evolution and expansion.


**Be A Part of A Special Community**

Our incredible students come from well over 100 different countries and this infuses our school
  

with vibrancy, inclusivity, tolerance, respect and support. Our highly qualified team of teachers
  

includes many leading educationalists and experts in their field who inspire the pupils to genuinely
  

be the best they can be.


We are dedicated to not only recruiting and retaining the best teachers, but also to ensuring that
  

we constantly develop and improve the education that they provide for our pupils through a focus
  

on training, coaching, research and innovation. Unlike many international schools, where high
  

rates of turnover are the norm, St Georgeʼs core faculty and leadership have chosen to stay
  

long\-term and to build lives in Rome. The large number of children of staff who attend the school,
  

across all phases, further contributes to a family atmosphere.


Our resolute commitment to independence and to our not\-for\-profit status further differentiate St
  

Georgeʼs from others and allows us to invest all retained earnings in the quality of our studentsʼ
  

experience.


**School Accolades Include**

* **Top 10 Private Schools in Europe, Spears Index (2025, 2024\)**

 **Top 15 Schools in Europe: Schools Index by Carfax (2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020\)** **Finalist, British International School of the Year, International Schools of the Year****Awards (October 2024\)** **Top 100 IB Schools in the World (Summer 2025 Examination Session)** **British School Overseas (BSO) Accredited Status (2024 \- 2027\)** **COBIS Accredited Member with Double Beacon Status (*****Learning \& Teaching,***

***Governance*****) (2023\)** **Newcastle United Foundation Football School (the Club and Foundationʼs first**

**International School partner)** **ABRSM Partner Programme School (Second Worldwide International School Partner)** **Trinity Cultural Experience Badge (2025/2026\)** **AFEC (Athlete Friendly Education Centre) School (one of just 40 worldwide)** **UAL Art \& Design Foundation Diploma Accreditation (one of only four centres outside of**

**the UK)**  



Our Commitment to Safeguarding  

  



Our schoolʼs practices reflect and are aligned with the written Expectations of the International
  

Taskforce on Child Protection.  

  



St Georgeʼs British International School is committed to safeguarding and to promoting the safety
  

and welfare of children, young people and adults. Every member of staff employed at St Georgeʼs
  

has a responsibility to safeguard. St Georgeʼs endeavours to provide a safe and welcoming
  

environment where all staff and learners are respected and valued.
  

  

The schoolʼs Safeguarding and Child Protection Policy, applicable to all employees, includes the
  

procedures for spotting and reporting child protection concerns, the role of Designated
  

Safeguarding Leads, procedures, actions, referral processes and support measures.  

  



**Vice Principal \- Senior School**  

St Georgeʼs British International School is seeking an experienced and inspirational Vice Principal
  

to serve as Head of the Senior School at the La Storta Campus.
  

  

The Vice Principal \- Senior School is responsible for defining and delivering St Georgeʼs vision for
  

Secondary education, ensuring that studentsʼ learning, well\-being and enjoyment are consistently
  

excellent. The Vice Principal \- Senior School leads with integrity, clarity and ambition for every
  

child, modelling and driving forward St Georgeʼs core values of internationalism, inclusivity and
  

excellence. The Vice Principal \- Senior School works closely with other members of the school
  

Leadership Team on whole\-school strategy development and delivery. The Vice Principal \- Senior
  

School is a member of St Georgeʼs four\-person Executive Leadership team, along with the
  

Principal/CEO and Vice Principals responsible for Junior Schools and for Finance and Operations,
  

respectively. The Vice Principal \- Senior School reports to the Principal/CEO.

  

**Duties and Responsibilities**
  

  

**Leadership, Management and Strategy**

* Within the framework of St Georgeʼs Values and Strategy, and in conjunction with the

Principal/CEO, define and implement a clear and compelling vision for the Senior School,
  

including the Sixth Form.
* Lead and manage the day\-to\-day operations of the Senior School, including line managing

that schoolʼs Leadership Team.
* Lead continuous school improvement planning for the Senior School, including rigorous

self\-evaluation and the development of realistic improvement targets.
* Ensure the Senior School complies with any and all relevant statutory and regulatory

requirements.
* Ensure the Senior School complies with all relevant St Georgeʼs policies and procedures.
* Manage Senior School admissions in collaboration with the Head of Marketing,

Communications and Admissions and the Principal/CEO.
* Oversee resourcing, including staffing and staffing\-related matters, and budgeting for the
Senior Schools in\-line with agreed whole school targets and in consultation with the
  

Principal/CEO and the Chief Financial Officer.


* Report to the Principal/CEO in a timely manner on all matters pertaining to the Senior

School.
* In relation to Senior School matters, to deputise for the Principal/CEO in their absence.
* Contribute to the development and delivery of the St Georgeʼs Strategy as part of the

Leadership Team.
  

  

**Curriculum, Teaching and Learning**

* Ensure studentsʼ learning, well\-being and enjoyment are central to all Senior School

activity and that the curriculum, schemes of work, assessment practices and teaching
  

strategies remain relevant, effective and consistently applied.
* Monitor and evaluate the quality of teaching and learning, in\-line with whole school

policies and practice, implementing improvement strategies where needed.
* Promote high expectations and achievement for all students, ensuring that individual

learning and pastoral needs, including SEND, are identified early and supported
  

appropriately.
* Champion the effective use of technology to support learning.
* Ensure clear, accurate and timely reporting to parents, consistent with St Georgeʼs wider

policy and practice.
* Develop and promote extracurricular opportunities that enrich studentsʼ experience and
support St Georgeʼs values.
* Work effectively with Junior colleagues to support smooth transitions across academic
phases.  

  



**Pastoral Care and Student Wellbeing**

* Ensure that students and staff are safe and feel safe at all times.
* Ensure a safe, inclusive and equitable learning environment where all students and staff

feel valued.
* To lead the further development and support of whole school behaviour systems in
support of students whose life experience may have hampered their ability to self\-regulate.
* To communicate candidly, respectfully and regularly with parents about studentsʼ
achievement, behaviour, personal development and well\-being.  

  

  

  

**Community, Culture and Collaboration**

* Foster a positive, collaborative and professional team culture, based on St Georgeʼs core

values of internationalism, inclusivity and excellence, and reinforcing a strong sense of
  

community in the Senior School and the wider school.
* Ensure productive and effective teamwork and lead robust processes for staff induction,

performance standards, continuing professional development and self\-evaluation.
* Provide coaching, guidance, motivation and, when necessary, appropriate corrective

action to ensure high professional performance.
* Lead the teaching staff recruitment, induction, appraisal and professional review within

the Senior Schools, consistent with the schoolʼs wider policy and practice.
* Establish and maintain effective dialogue with Senior School parents and contribute to the

development of effective home\-school partnerships.
* Build strong and constructive relationships with other British international schools from

which St Georgeʼs can learn.
* Actively promote the Senior Schools as part of St Georgeʼs rich educational offer internally

DURATION: 11 months**BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE OF THE ASSIGNMENT:**


The United Nations World Food Programme (WFP) is the world's largest humanitarian agency, fighting hunger worldwide. We are seeking to fill the position of Disability Inclusion Officer based at our Headquarters in Rome, Italy or remotely. WFP is well\-known for its ability to deliver food assistance rapidly to people in need. In order to respond effectively in the challenging contexts in which WFP operates, staff require sound knowledge of the fundamentals of programming, as well as skills in specialized areas, such as humanitarian access, protection, accountability to affected populations (AAP), and conflict sensitive programming. The Gender, Protection and Inclusion (GPI) team at WFP Headquarters supports the integration of gender equality, protection and inclusion considerations across WFP’s policies, programmes and operations. This includes strengthening how evidence is generated, analysed and used to inform programme design, implementation, and corporate reporting, and ensuring that people\-centred approaches are consistently reflected across the programme cycle. The Programme Quality and Excellence team within GPI ensures that high standards of each thematic area covered by GPI, including Disability Inclusion, remain adequately addressed in WFP’s programmes and operations. Under the overall supervision of the Senior Disability Inclusion Advisor, the Disability Inclusion Officer will undertake the following duties

**ACCOUNTABILITIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:**


Five workstreams

**Engagement with Organizations of Persons with Disabilities (OPDs)**

* Lead OPD engagement work on behalf of WFP.
* Develop and foster partnerships with OPDs on behalf of WFP at the global and regional level that are mutually beneficial to both WFP and OPD partners.
* Update guidelines and roll\-out for consultation with persons with disabilities, namely through their representative organizations, that ensure accessibility and inclusiveness, and promote representation of the diversity of persons with disabilities and intersectionality.
* Streamline systems for consultation with OPDs globally, including through direct contributions to the BHA project \- Outcome 2 – Engage as well as other aspects of the Localization Portfolio insofar as they relate to Disability Inclusion.
* In collaboration with the Partnerships division, review and update field level agreements and/or other partnership frameworks to reflect the relationship with OPDs.

**Accessibility**

* Work across support GHQ and CO functions to provide support on accessibility related topics including through the ED Assurance Framework and as part of WFP minimum programming standards.
* Promote accessibility of the built environment at WFP headquarters and across country offices through establishment and implementation of standards and guidance.
* Support completion of ICT accessibility assessment and progress of implementation of emanating recommendations.
* Support with baseline assessment and subsequent approach for ensuring accessibility of Conferences and Services in collaboration with the Conference Servicing Unit

**Supporting Country Offices and Global HQ Regions**

* Provide technical assistance and capacity building to Regionally Outposted Colleagues and COs, in partnership with cross\-cutting Protection, AAP, Gender and/or Disability Inclusion regional or CO advisors.
* Support and provide technical support to at least one Regional Office to develop and manage their DI work plans, including Regional/ CO workplans. Provide back\-up support for a second Regional Office.
* Support DI mainstreaming throughout Country Strategic Plans through the FAR (CSP); data collection and utilization for CSP development, Annual Country Reporting and CRF reporting.

**Cross Functional**

* Provide guidance to the Steering Committee and the Working Group in relevant policy and technical areas with respect to the deliverables particularly in relation to the roll out of UNDIS 2\.0
* Deliver accessible trainings on consultation with OPDs, accessibility, reasonable accommodation and other related topics reflected in this TOR.
* Participate in relevant employee resources groups or working groups related to disability inclusion as well as to the Community of Practice for DI.
* Contribute to future strategy development on disability inclusion including capacity strengthening plans.

**People Operations/Human Resources**

* Provide technical support and recommendations to Human Resources on Reasonable Accommodation through rolling out the Reasonable Accommodation guidance and policy in line with the Diversity \& Inclusion team requests.
* Provide strategic inputs and guidance to existing human resources policies and processes from the disability inclusion perspective, as requested.
* Embed disability inclusion throughout end\-to\-end recruitment cycle to increase employment of persons with disabilities at WFP.
* Work with recruiters and human resources globally to enhance knowledge, capacity and practices on recruitment, retention and career development.
* Assist with capacity building initiatives (on\-line and in person) as well as advocacy materials in co\-ordination with the Diversity and Inclusion Team

**DELIVERABLES AT THE END OF THE CONTRACT:**

* Update guidance note on enabling persons with disabilities to participate in all processes that that assess, plan, design, implement, monitor and evaluate WFP operations and programming, at the headquarters, regional and country levels in line with GPI minimum standards as well as UNDIS 2\.0 programme standards and FAR integration
* Partnerships with key representative OPDs at the global, regional and country office levels including those set up through the Engage programme and relevant contracting mechansims
* Project plan for Regional Roll outs of concerned ROs including budget, timelines and monitoring information with action plans and reporting on all Country Office progress within the selected Regions.
* Technical assistance to COs on GPI minimum standards as well as specific technical advice provided on targeted DI interventions. These will be categorized through assistance for the Integrated Context Analysis and Risk Assessment tool, the FAR, the Gender Equality Certification Programme \+ DI and other GPI corporate processes.
* Training on all new UNDIS indicators through the DIWG Focal Points system, the Disability Inclusion Network and the COP\-DI

Masters degree in one or more of the following disciplines: social sciences, development studies, international relations, sociology or other relevant field.

* Demonstrated field and policy\-oriented experience working on disability inclusion is required.

The FAO Livestock Environmental Assessment and Performance (LEAP) Partnership is a dynamic multistakeholder initiative committed to improving the environmental performance of livestock supply chains while ensuring their economic and social viability. The partnership develops comprehensive guidelines and methodologies to assess the environmental performance of livestock supply chains. The objective is to provide stakeholders with the tools and insights needed to shape evidence\-based policy measures and business strategies, ultimately driving positive change within the livestock sector. The Partnership encourages dialogues and facilitates collaboration among diverse stakeholder groups, including governments, the private sector, academia, NGOs and civil society organizations.


Hosted by the FAO Animal Production and Health Division, the Secretariat ensures that the FAO LEAP activities are grounded in international best practices. As a central coordinating body of the Partnership, the Secretariat provides technical and administrative support to the FAO LEAP partners. In addition, it facilitates the work of Technical Advisory Groups (TAGs), guiding the content development of the guidelines and ensuring their alignment with FAO and the Partnership's mission.

The incumbent will serve as a full member of the Secretariat of the FAO LEAP Partnership, providing technical and administrative support to strengthen its governance, coordination, knowledge sharing, outreach and work programme delivery. Job summary  

Amazon Operations sits at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. We look after everything from the moment a customer clicks buy, to the moment their item is delivered – from desktop to doorstep.  

  

Across Europe we have more than 50 Fulfillment Centers, hundreds of Delivery Stations, thousands of machines, and tens of thousands of employees, all working together in harmony to make sure the right item gets delivered to the right person, in the right place, at the right time.  

  

Working in Amazon Operations is for people who like to be active and give their all. We work in a busy, dynamic environment and are part of a bigger team delivering on the expectations of millions of customers every single day.  

  

  

We are open, inclusive and welcome individuality and diversity. The culture in our Operation is built on the way teams bond and the work ethic that enables our business run like clockwork. Our teams take pride in a job well done, looking out for one another, ensuring the highest safety standards and playing their part in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for around the world.  

  

Join us in the Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering team. We maintain and optimize technologies in the Global Amazon Warehouse \& Delivery Network.  

  

PURPOSE OF THE JOB:  

  

We are looking for motivated, customer\-focused people who want to join our team as a Reliability Maintenance Engineering Technician.
  

  

The focus of the Reliability Maintenance Engineering Technician role is to ensure safety regulations and policies are adhered to, to ensure preventative maintenance is conducted on time to a high standard and to provide high levels of equipment availability through continuous improvement.
  

  

Shift Pattern: This role includes working in non\-traditional shift pattern, which may include nights and weekends  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Put health \& safety best practices first in all work carried out ensuring compliance with all health \& safety standards and regulations.
* Carry out planned preventative maintenance on the full range of equipment within the site.
* React quickly to breakdowns, communicate clearly with affected parties and work efficiently to fix the issue.
* Support continuous improvement by learning from breakdowns and sending feedback and suggestions for improvements through the line manager.
* Provide high levels of equipment availability to our internal customers.
* Support and learn from Senior Reliability Engineering Technicians.
* Management of contractors.

* On\-site support and responsibility for management and escalation of high severity tickets.

A day in the life

title: RADAR Specialist
description:
Il **Gruppo FOS** opera da oltre 25 anni nei settori **ICT** ed **Engineering**.  

Presente sul territorio nazionale ed internazionale con sedi a Genova, Roma, Milano, Pietrelcina (BN), Caserta, Bolzano, Napoli, Torino, Verona e Vilnius (Lituania).  

Si propone come partner dei propri clienti accompagnandoli nei cambiamenti tecnologici e nelle sfide innovative attraverso l’ideazione, la progettazione, lo sviluppo e la manutenzione di prodotti e servizi. Siamo specializzati in ICT Services, ICT Solutions, servizi e soluzioni di Ingegneria.

Ricerchiamo un/una **RADAR Specialist** per la sede di Roma.

Focus del ruolo:
Analisi delle forme d’onda RADAR complesse e gestione dei dati, con il contributo alla definizione dei requisiti tecnici per l’acquisizione di sistemi di intercettazione dei segnali RADAR.

Scopo della posizione:
L’Esperto RADAR è incaricato di condurre l’analisi tecnica dei segnali RADAR prodotti da sistemi moderni e complessi, garantendo un’interpretazione accurata delle forme d’onda. Il professionista si occupa di catalogare e documentare i dati RADAR all’interno di banche dati dedicate, fornendo informazioni strategiche per il miglioramento delle capacità di intercettazione. In aggiunta, contribuirà attivamente alla redazione dei requisiti tecnici necessari alla specifica.

Requisiti:
– Conoscenze:* Tecnologie RADAR:  

	+ Principi di funzionamento dei sistemi RADAR (emissione, ricezione, modulazione e demodulazione);
	+ Conoscenza dei diversi tipi di RADAR (pulse\-Doppler, FMCW, bistatici, etc.) e delle rispettive applicazioni in ambito militare.
* Analisi dei segnali e forme d’onda:  

	+ Metodiche di analisi spettrale e utilizzo di tecniche di *Digital Signal Processing* (DSP);
	+ Capacità di interpretare le forme d’onda, dalla loro acquisizione fino all’analisi in dominio tempo\-frequenza (ad es. trasformata di Fourier, wavelet).
* Gestione di Banche Dati Tecniche:  

	+ Conoscenza dei sistemi di archiviazione e gestione di dati RADAR; utilizzo di piattaforme e strumenti specifici per la documentazione e la descrizione dei segnali.
* Normative e Standard di Sicurezza:  

	+ Familiarità con le normative e gli *standard* militari in tema di sicurezza, interoperabilità e prestazioni dei sistemi RADAR e dei sistemi di intercettazione.
* Intercettazione RADAR:  

	+ Fondamenti relativi ai sistemi di intercettazione e analisi dei segnali RADAR, compresi i processi di acquisizione, elaborazione e validazione delle informazioni raccolte.



– Competenze Professionali:* Analisi Tecnica dei Segnali:  

	+ Capacità di eseguire analisi approfondite sulle forme d’onda RADAR, identificando caratteristiche, anomalie e *pattern* significativi per l’ottimizzazione dei sistemi.
* Descrizione e Catalogazione dei Dati:  

	+ Redazione di descrizioni tecniche dettagliate di segnali RADAR e inserimento accurato dei dati all’interno di banche dati dedicate, garantendo la reperibilità e la fruibilità delle informazioni.
* Progettazione di Requisiti Tecnici:  

	+ Contributo attivo alla stesura e al miglioramento dei requisiti tecnici per l’acquisizione di sistemi di intercettazione, in seguito a valutazioni dei segnali e dei sistemi in uso.
* Utilizzo di Strumenti di Analisi:  

	+ Esperienza nell’uso di software e strumenti specifici per l’analisi dei dati RADAR (ad es. MATLAB, strumenti di DSP, piattaforme di database) e nella modellazione delle forme d’onda.


– Competenze Trasversali:* + Comunicazione Tecnica:  
	
		- Abilità di comunicare concetti complessi in modo chiaro e comprensibile, sia verbalmente che per iscritto, adattandosi sia a interlocutori tecnici che non tecnici.
	+ Orientamento al Dettaglio e Precisione:  
	
		- Elevata attenzione ai dettagli nella raccolta, analisi e documentazione dei dati RADAR, essenziale per garantire la qualità e l’affidabilità delle informazioni.
	+ *Problem Solving*:  
	
		- Capacità di individuare criticità e sviluppare soluzioni innovative in contesti operativi complessi, anche sotto pressione.
	+ Lavoro in *Team*:  
	
		- Predisposizione alla collaborazione con colleghi di diverse discipline (ingegneria, *cybersecurity*, *project management*) e capacità di coordinare le attività condivise.
	+ Flessibilità e Adattabilità:  
	
		- Propensione ad aggiornarsi costantemente su nuove tecnologie e metodologie, con capacità di adeguarsi rapidamente ai cambiamenti tecnologici e operativi.


– Responsabilità Organizzative:* + Coordinamento e Collaborazione Interdisciplinare:  
	
		- Partecipare attivamente alle riunioni di team, favorendo lo scambio di informazioni e il coordinamento con reparti tecnici e di ingegneria.
	+ Gestione dei Flussi Informativi:  
	
		- Organizzare e supervisionare la raccolta, l’archiviazione e l’aggiornamento dei dati RADAR nelle banche dati dedicate, assicurando l’integrità e la tracciabilità delle informazioni.
	+ Supporto alle Attività di Progetto:  
	
		- Collaborare nella pianificazione e nel monitoraggio delle attività dei progetti in corso, contribuendo alla definizione delle priorità e allo sviluppo di nuove iniziative strategiche.
	+ Definizione delle Procedure Operative:  
	
		- Partecipare alla definizione e all’aggiornamento dei processi e delle metodologie operative per l’analisi dei segnali RADAR, garantendo il rispetto degli *standard* di qualità e sicurezza.


– Responsabilità Professionali:* + Analisi e Interpretazione delle Forme d’Onda:  
	
		- Effettuare l’analisi tecnica e l’interpretazione dettagliata delle forme d’onda RADAR, valutandone le caratteristiche per identificare criticità e opportunità di miglioramento.
	+ Redazione di Documentazione Tecnica:  
	
		- Produrre *report* e documentazione tecnica che descrivano in modo rigoroso i segnali analizzati, facilitando la consultazione e il riutilizzo delle informazioni in progetti futuri.
	+ Definizione dei Requisiti Tecnici:  
	
		- Contribuire alla stesura dei requisiti tecnici per l’acquisizione di sistemi di intercettazione RADAR, offrendo un supporto specializzato basato sull’analisi dei segnali e sulle prestazioni dei sistemi esistenti.
	+ Supporto Operativo e Aggiornamento Tecnico:  
	
		- Fornire competenze tecniche durante le attività operative e di manutenzione dei sistemi, nonché contribuire alla formazione e all’aggiornamento dei colleghi sulle nuove metodologie e tecnologie RADAR.


Questa posizione richiede un professionista altamente qualificato, capace di coniugare competenze tecniche approfondite con capacità organizzative e relazionali, al fine di garantire l’eccellenza operativa nei sistemi RADAR e nei processi di intercettazione.

Inquadramento professionale e retributivo saranno commisurati all’effettiva esperienza e seniority.
